links.comparator_used: No AI feedback (participants' diagnosis without saliency/heatmap feedback); the abstract does not state the comparator explicitly
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of student and qualified radiographers on binary diagnosis of skeletal radiographs
links.effect: No numbers reported in the abstract. AI feedback (saliency/heatmaps and AI diagnosis with percentage confidence) was beneficial to accuracy in all cases except when the AI was incorrect and for pathological cases in the student group.
links.tradeoff: Accuracy did not benefit when the AI was incorrect, or for pathological cases in the student group. Self-reported trust of all participants decreased from the beginning to the end of the study.
links.quote: The AI feedback proved beneficial to accuracy in all cases except when the AI was incorrect and for pathological cases in the student group.
